screen.redstone_utils.toolbox.subtitle: All build and analysis tools in one place.
config.redstone_utils.hud.title: HUD Layer
config.redstone_utils.hud.description: Controls Redstone Utils popups and the radial wheel.
config.redstone_utils.hud.tooltip: The configuration and toolbox screens remain available when disabled.
config.redstone_utils.status_hud.title: Active Status HUD
config.redstone_utils.status_hud.descrip: Shows AutoWire mode, overlays, freeze state, and backend availability.
config.redstone_utils.status_hud.tooltip: A compact diagnostic panel visible during play.
config.redstone_utils.status_anchor.desc: Selects the corner used by the status panel.
config.redstone_utils.status_anchor.tool: Cycle through the four screen corners.
config.redstone_utils.feedback.title: Feedback Output
config.redstone_utils.feedback.descripti: Selects popup, chat, action bar, or a combined output.
config.redstone_utils.feedback.tooltip: Applies to normal Redstone Utils feedback messages.
config.redstone_utils.teleport.title: Teleport Range
config.redstone_utils.teleport.descripti: Maximum raycast distance from 10 to 1,000 blocks.
config.redstone_utils.teleport.tooltip: Click to type an exact value or use the slider.
config.redstone_utils.autowire.title: Active Wire Mode
config.redstone_utils.autowire.descripti: Chooses the component placed above each new support block.
config.redstone_utils.autowire.tooltip: The selected mode is synchronized with the server on join.
config.redstone_utils.wire_preview.title: Wire Preview
config.redstone_utils.wire_preview.descr: Previews the support block and AutoWire result before placement.
config.redstone_utils.wire_preview.toolt: Can be frozen together with the analysis overlays.
config.redstone_utils.bud.title: BUD Switch Overlay
config.redstone_utils.bud.description: Highlights armed quasi-connectivity BUD states and their active power sources.
config.redstone_utils.bud.tooltip: Red marks stale components; yellow marks the active quasi-power keeping them stale.
config.redstone_utils.bud_range.title: BUD Search Radius
config.redstone_utils.bud_range.descript: Spherical analysis radius from 4 to 64 blocks.
config.redstone_utils.bud_range.tooltip: Large values increase scanning work considerably.
config.redstone_utils.sculk.title: Sculk Overlay
config.redstone_utils.sculk.description: Displays vibration ranges and wool occlusion.
config.redstone_utils.sculk.tooltip: Normal and calibrated sensors are detected.
config.redstone_utils.sculk_distance.des: Sensor discovery distance from 16 to 256 blocks.
config.redstone_utils.sculk_distance.too: The global overlay distance can cap this value.
config.redstone_utils.freeze.title: Overlay Snapshot
config.redstone_utils.freeze.description: Freezes the latest wire, BUD, and sculk analysis.
config.redstone_utils.freeze.tooltip: Move around while the captured geometry remains in place.
config.redstone_utils.palette.title: Color Palette
config.redstone_utils.palette.tooltip: Affects wire, BUD, and sculk overlay colors.
config.redstone_utils.wire_color.title: Wire Preview Color
config.redstone_utils.wire_color.descrip: Custom RGB color for AutoWire preview geometry.
config.redstone_utils.wire_color.tooltip: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #33DD55.
config.redstone_utils.risk_color.title: BUD Risk Color
config.redstone_utils.risk_color.descrip: Custom RGB color for armed quasi-connectivity components.
config.redstone_utils.risk_color.tooltip: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #FF3838.
config.redstone_utils.source_color.title: BUD Source Color
config.redstone_utils.source_color.descr: Custom RGB color for active quasi-power sources.
config.redstone_utils.source_color.toolt: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #FFD43B.
config.redstone_utils.sculk_color.title: Sculk Range Color
config.redstone_utils.sculk_color.descri: Custom RGB color for sensor range geometry.
config.redstone_utils.sculk_color.toolti: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #4EC9FF.
config.redstone_utils.opacity.title: Overlay Opacity
config.redstone_utils.opacity.tooltip: Click for exact input and a slider.
config.redstone_utils.line_width.title: Overlay Line Width
config.redstone_utils.line_width.descrip: Sets outline width from 1 to 8 pixels.
config.redstone_utils.line_width.tooltip: Thicker lines improve visibility at high resolutions.
config.redstone_utils.through_walls.desc: Draws analysis geometry even when blocks obstruct it.
config.redstone_utils.popup_anchor.title: Popup Position
config.redstone_utils.popup_anchor.descr: Selects the corner used by popup notifications.
config.redstone_utils.popup_anchor.toolt: Cycle through all four screen corners.
config.redstone_utils.popup_duration.too: Click for exact input and a slider.
config.redstone_utils.overlay_distance.d: Global analysis cap from 8 to 256 blocks.
config.redstone_utils.overlay_distance.t: Limits expensive BUD and sculk searches.
config.redstone_utils.sculk_interval.des: Geometry rebuild interval from 1 to 100 ticks.
config.redstone_utils.sculk_interval.too: Higher values reduce work for mostly static builds.
screen.redstone_utils.sculk_info.subtitl: Vibration events grouped by calibrated sensor frequency
